relations.rationale: If Eli is the tallest of the group, then Eli stands above Zeno, a member of the group.
If Eli is the tallest of the group, then Eli stands above Dara, a member of the group.
Eli's height has no bearing on the group's fatigue or satisfaction.

Eli standing above Zeno doesn't determine Eli's height relative to Dara, a separate person.
Eli standing above Zeno in height is unrelated to Zeno being the oldest in age.
Eli's height relative to Dara has no bearing on Zeno's age relative to Dara.
Eli's height relative to Dara is unrelated to Dara setting up a camp stove.

Eli's height relative to Dara is unrelated to Zeno spotting a hawk.

If Mina is on the same team as Eli, and separately Eli is on the same team as Zeno, this is consistent, but claim 14 alone doesn't establish Eli-Zeno team status, though it doesn't contradict it either; team overlap suggests support since same team as Eli increases likelihood of grouping with Eli's teammates.

If Mina is on the same team as Eli, and Eli is on the same team as Zeno (per other claims), this would contradict Mina not being on Zeno's team; but judged alone, Mina-Eli team membership doesn't directly address Mina-Zeno relationship.
The context of how the fact about Nell's ranking came up (comparing race bibs) supports the fact being true and known.
Nell's fastest ranking in a race is unrelated to Zeno's age being oldest.

The context of comparing race bibs is unrelated to Zeno's age relative to Dara.
Comparing race bibs to learn about Nell's ranking is unrelated to Mina's team membership relative to Zeno.
If Zeno was the oldest of the five, this supports the claim that Zeno is older than Dara, and the specific detail of by a couple of years is consistent with this.
